features.title: Create a new note
features.description: Implement the domain use case and local database schema additions to create a new empty note and post to server.
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can click + floating action button at home to create a new empty note.
verification: Launch the app by instrumented test
Click + floating action button at home.
Verify the empty note UI is displayed
Verify a POST API call is called with the correct note data

features.title: Send a message in the current conversation
features.description: Implement the sendMessage Retrofit API endpoint mapping and save the sent message into the local Room database thread.
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can submit a message and see it appear in the active thread.
verification: Type a message into the input.
Verify the new message appears in the thread.

features.title: Persist the active conversation list
features.description: Implement automatic offline syncing using a WorkManager sync worker that triggers when internet is restored.
features.user_visible_behavior: A user sees previously created conversations after restarting the app.
verification: Verify both conversations still appear in the sidebar.
